text:
elaine: Heads up — OrionCloud just pushed two racks (PO ORN-4721) ~3 weeks due to port congestion. Affects APAC Dedicated commitments and one upcoming marketplace commit. Need quick decision on swaps or compensating capacity.
marco: Ugh. Do we know which datacenter/region those racks were destined for in APAC? Can we patch with EU spares + inter-region routing? :thinking:
orion_partner_bot: Partner OrionCloud status update: ORN-4721 -> Estimated ship 2026-04-21 (was 2026-03-31). Cause: terminal labor shortage. Tracking #T-9221.
sreha: If we pull from EU pool we need ~24h to reconfigure routing rules and update canary policies. Also need to check compliance for customer C (data residency).
laura-ps: Customer C is eligible for cross-region fallback per contract but we must notify them 7 days prior per SLA. If we swap, ops needs an approved change note for the console and marketplace listing.
tim-supply: I can try to negotiate expedited loading with the carrier — cost delta estimate +$9k per rack. Also can ask partner to split the shipment so 1 of 2 arrives earlier.
elaines: Option A: take 2 racks from EU pool and route via temporary VPC peering + notify affected customers. Option B: pay expedited freight for the two racks to keep original allocation. Opinions?
marco: Option A seems lower cost but will reduce EU burst capacity for a week. Which customers would be impacted in EU?
jason: EU hit is smaller — only one small Dedicated pilot (internal non-SLA). We can deprioritize it. I vote A and keep marketplace commit cadence unchanged.
sreha: Quick checklist if we do A: 1) update routing policy in console (route-map swapboard-2026-03) 2) run canary for 1 hour 3) patch telemetry to flag perf/regressions. I can own steps 1+3.
laura-ps: I'll draft the customer notice and partner comms. We should avoid a joint announcement this week; push any marketing mention until capacity is stable.
tim-supply: Negotiation note: partner offered a 50% freight discount if we accept a partial split shipment (1 rack now, 1 later). Could save ~$4.5k vs full expedite.
marco: Let's do Option A (EU -> APAC swap) + accept split shipment if partner can promise earliest available for remaining rack. Elaine, can you confirm so I can start routing changes?
elaine: Confirmed. Marco, please start routing changes and tag me once route-map is ready. Sreha, thanks for owning telemetry. Laura, hold the marketing announcement for this week. Tim, continue carrier negotiation for split shipment and cost cap at +$7k.
jason: I'll update the dedicated-commit tracking board and add a note to the partner capacity dashboard.
orion_partner_bot: Partner OrionCloud log: split-shipment requested by Redwood at 2026-03-27T14:12Z. Awaiting partner confirmation.
elaine: Thanks everyone — small ask: capture the decision and cost delta in the reservation playbook so we can reference for future marketplace commits. :thumbsup:
